༄༅/ /'khor lo sdom pa bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs me tri pa'i dgongs don zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'khor lo sdom pa bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs

me tri pa'i dgongs don zhes bya ba bzhugs/ na mo ratna tra ya ya/ 'khor lo sdom pa bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs me tri pa'i dgongs don zhes bya ba/ bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sna tshogs sgeg pa'i nyams rgyas shing*// bcu gnyis yan lag ma dang rol/ /spros kun 'od gsal chen por sdom/ /bla ma 'khor lo'i mgon la 'dud/ / dben pa'i gnas su stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang*/ / sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' che/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs kun/ / thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /rkang gnyis gtso bo'i sku gsung thugs/ /bcom ldan 'das la skyabs su mchi/ /'dod chags bral zhing mya ngan 'das/ /zhi ba'i chos la skyabs su mchi/ /tshogs kyi mchog gyur sa la bzhugs/ /phyir ma ི ldog la skyabs su mchi/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /bla ma mchog la skyabs su mchi/ /dngos grub gter ba'i yi dam lha/ / dkyil 'khor lha la skyabs su mchi/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo rnal 'byor tshogs/ / mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi/ /stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa'i/ / gnyug ma'i sems la skyabs su mchi/ /j-i ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ / zhes pa nas/ sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ / ces pa'i bar gyis sems bskyed la sdom pa bzung*/ de nas he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pa'i sgom bzlas bya ba spyi dang mthun/ oṃ shrī he ru kahaṃ/ rang skad cig gis phyag gnyis par gsal ba'i thugs khar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ sngon po/ de las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pa/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar badzra sa mā dzaḥ gang gi 'khor ba'i nyes pa ni/ /dran pa tsam gyis 'joms mdzad cing*/ /bla med byang chub thob mdzad pa/ /bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ / zhes pa nas/ de rnyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes pa'i bar gyis phyag 'tshal/ oṃ gu ru shrī badzra he ru ka

sarba bi ra yo gi ni arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ de bzhin du padyaṃ/ puṣpe nas shapta 'i bar gyis mchod/ ri rab gling bzhi gling phran nyi zla lcags rir bcas/ / rin chen sna bdun gter gyi bum pas legs bkang nas/ /bdag lus longs spyod snang srid bcas pa kun 'bul na/ /thugs rje chen pos dgongs nas 'di dag bzhes su gsol/ /byas dang byed du bcug dang yi rang ba'i/ /sdig pa ma lus skyon kun 'jig byed pa'i/ /spyan sngar so sor bshags shing slar yang ni/ / mi byed pa yi sdom pa blang bar bgyi/ /nyan thos rang rgyal bla med rgyal ba dang*/ / rgyal ba'i sras kyis dge ba gang mdzad pa/ /de dag kun la yang dag yi rang shing*/ /byang chub tu ni yongs su bsngo bar bgyi/ /rgyal ba dkon mchog la sogs gsum po la/ /dngos po kun gyi bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems bskyed de bzhin du/ /bla na med pa'i lam la brten par bgyi/ / 'gro ba'i don phyir sangs rgyas 'phrin las rnams/ /ma lus rdzogs par bdag gis bgyid par shog / ces lan gsum gyis rgyun bshags bya/ de nas tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par sgom/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las/ yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam yam̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum ram̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du bam̐ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bam̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du lam̐ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi lam̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du sum̐ las ri rab rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa/ de'i steng du pam̐ las sna tshogs padma'i lte bar hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra ba/ dra ba/ gur bla re zla'i dra ba/ phyi rol kun tu ye shes kyi me 'od 'bar ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/

oṃ be dhi ni badzrī bha ba badzra bandha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra pra ka ra hūm̐ pam̐ hūm̐/ oṃ badzra pañtsa ra hūm̐ yam̐ hūm̐/ oṃ badzra bi ta na hūm̐ kham̐ hūm̐/ oṃ badzra sa ra dza la traṃ sam̐ traṃ/ oṃ badzra dzwa la a na la ra ka hūm̐ hūm̐/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la bhrum̐ las 'od 'phros/ lus yongs su gyur pa las/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal med khang/ gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ rtsigs pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ pha gu dang*/ bre phul dang*/ gser gyi snam bu dang*/ dra phyed dang*/ shar bu dang mda' yab dang*/ bzung ma rnams dang bcas pa'i kha khyer te/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ sgo bzhi'i steng du ka bas btegs pa'i rta babs snam bu bzhi dang bcas pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i thogs phugs can/ nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ byang ljang*/ nub dmar/ lho ser/ mtshams rnams su bum pa brgyad dang bcas pa/ dbus su sna tshogs padma 'bad ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan/ phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma dang*/ sgo mtshams brgyad du ro'i gdan dang bcas pa/ gzhal med khang gi phyi rol mchod pa'i bkod pa thams cad dang bcas shing*/ pad 'dab kyi 'khor yug bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i phyi rol du dur khrod chen po brgyad/ phyogs skyong ba dang/ zhing skyong ba dang*/ shing dang*/ me dang*/ sprin dang*/ chu dang*/ ri dang*/ mchod brten dang*/ grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis yongs su gang ba'o/ /dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ g.yon skor gyi/ a ā nas/ aṃ aḥ zhes pa'i bar phrag gnyis/ zhu ba las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du g.yas skor gya ི ka kha nas/ ha kṣa/ ya ra la ba ḍa ḍha phrag gnyis/ zhu ba las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de gnyis kyi bar du hūm̐ sngon po/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/

tshur 'dus/ de thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa yongs su gyur pa las/ lha bcu gsum yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du 'khor lo bde mchog / sku mdog mthing kha zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal sngon po/ g.yon ljang*/ rgyab dmar/ g.yas ser/ zhal rnam par 'gyur ba/ spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing*/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyi rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum las 'khyud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i lpags pa rgyangs te 'dzin pa/ g.yas kyi gsum pa na ḍā ma ru/ bzhi pa na dgra sta/ lnga pa na gri gug /drug pa na mdung rtse gsum pa 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi gsum pa na kha ṭwāṃ ga /bzhi pa na khrag gi gang ba'i thod pa/ lnga pa na rdo rje zhags pa/ drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzh-i pa 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang pas dus mtshan ma dang*/ g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed nag po mnan pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ zla ba phyed pa dang*/ nor bu rin chen dang*/ thod pa skam po lngas dbu brgyan pa/ phyag rgya drug dang mgo'i 'phreng ba can/ stag gi lpags pa'-i sham thabs grol ba/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ g.yon thod khrag dang kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud cing*/ g.yas sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i rdo rje 'phyar ba/ byin pa gnyis kyis yab la 'khril ba/ skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ thod skam gyi do shal can/ khrag la dgos shing khrag 'dzag pa'o/ /gnyis ka'ang bskal pa'i me lta bu'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur/ shar gyi 'dab ma la mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ /byang du lā ma ljang khu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ /lhor gzugs can ma ser skya/ mtshams bzhir bum pa/ byang chub kyi sems kyis gang ba'i steng du/ ka pā la bdud rtsis gang ba dang bcas pa bzhi'o/ /shar sgor khwa gdong ma nag mo/

byang sgor 'ug gdong ma ljang khu/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo/ /shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya ma g.yas ser g.yon dmar/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ thams cad kyang drag mo'i gzugs can/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum ma phyag g.yas gnyis na gri gug dang ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gnyis na thod pa dang kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing skra grol ba/ rdo rje'i 'phreng bas dbu la brgyan cing mi mgo'i do shal can/ ro'i gdan la g.yas brkyang gi skabs kyi gnas pas dngos grub thams cad stsol ba'o/ /lha thams cad kyi spyir bor oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par āḥlas dang padma dmar po āḥs mtshan pa/ thugs khar hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ yab kyi snying khar oṃ ha las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po/ mgon bor na ma hi las rnam par snang mdzad ser po/ spyi gtsug tu swāhā hūm̐ las rin chen 'byung ldan dmar po/ phrag pa gnyis su nau ṣaṭa he las he ru ka nag po/ mig gnyis la hūm̐ hūm̐ ho las 'od dpag med mthing ka / yan lag thams cad la phaṭa haṃ las rta mchog ljang khu rnams rdo rje dang*/ dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /mig tu oṃ las gti mug rdo rje dkar po rna bar hūm̐ las zhe sdang rdo rje nag po/ snar khaṃ las phrag dog rdo rje ljang khu/ lcer oṃ las 'dod chags rdo rje dmar po/ dpral bar traṃ las ser sna rdo rje ser po/ snying khar hūm̐ las dbang phyug rdo rje sngon po rnams/ rdo rje dang thod pa 'dzin par gyur/ yum gyi lte bar oṃ bam̐ las rdo rje phag mo dmar mo/ snying khar haṃ oṃ las gshin rje ma sngon po/ khar hriṃ mam̐ rmongs byed ma dkar mo/ dpral bar hreṃ hriṃ las bskyod byed ma ser mo/

spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ las skrag med ma ljang khu/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa las tsaṇḍi ka dud kha rnams gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin par gyur/ rang gi thugs kha'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis/ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan drangs/ phaiṃ/ dza ཿ hūm̐ baṃ ho ཿ gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ yo gā shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo gā shuddho3haṃ/ slar yang 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ phaiṃ/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyi ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ yum la rnam snang*/ phyogs ma bzhi la rin 'byung*/ sgo ma bzhi la snang mtha'/ mtshams ma bzhi la don grub kyi dbu brgya par gyur/ ā li kā li lan gsum du brjod cing*/ ro brkyang gi lam nas ā li kā li'i 'gro 'ong byas pas rtsa lam khyab par mos/ maṇḍal mchod chog rgyas pa spro na skabs 'dir bya ba/ gnyis med rdo rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i gzhung gi dngos bstan ltar ram/ spros pa la dga' na bla ma gong ma rnams kyi yig cha ltar bya'o/ /'on kyang skabs 'di nyid kyis cho ga'i yan lag tu de dgos pa ni ma yin no/ /'dus zhabs lugs ltar mchod lha mkha' nang nas spros te/ gong bzhin du arghaṃ nas shapta 'i bar gyis mchod/ lha rnams kyi rang sngags kyi nang mchod myang*/ gsang mchod bya/ rkang pa brgyad pa'i sngags kyis bstod/ 'khor lo'i dmigs pa gsal btab la bzlas pa bya ste/ oṃ shrī badzra he ru ka ḍā ki nī dzwa la samba ra swāhā/ snying po'o/ / oṃ hrī ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ nye ba'i snying po'o/ / oṃ badzra bai ro tsa ne ye hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/

yum gyi snying po'o/ / oṃ sarba buddha ḍā' ki nī ye badzra warṇa ni ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ nye ba'i snying po'o/ /ma mo bcu gnyis kyi sngags ni spyi dang mtshungs so/ / rang gi snying kha'i 'od zer gyis snang ba thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor gyur/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil la thim/ dkyil 'khor yang 'od gsal gyi dbyings su thim/ slar yang phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par langs te/ go cha gnyis kyis rgyas btab la/ thun mtshams la 'jug go /gtor ma'i cho ga ni/ sdom pa 'byung ba bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs su bshad zin yin la 'dor chen gyi khyad par lwa ba bcu gsum ma'i skabs su 'chad pa ltar yin pas/ de dang der lta bar bya'o/ /gnyis med rdo rje'i dgongs pa bzhin// nyung ngu'i tshig gi mdor bsdus nas/ /don zab don ni rgya che ba/ /blo dman rnams la gsal bar byas/ /'khor lo sdom pa bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs/ mai tri pa'-ii dgongs don zhes bya ba/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas skye bo mang po la phan par mthong zhing*/ bdag dang skal mnyam gzhan gyi don du sbyar ba ste/ rang lo sum cu pa la/ thub bstan gser mdog can du'o/ /dar rgyas 'phel// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/'khor lo sdom pa bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs me tri pa'i dgongs don zhes bya ba bzhugs/ - PAGE 360 -- PAGE 359 -- PAGE 357 -
